title: 租房与居住精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 这套房的租金包含水费和暖气费吗？
items.en: Does the rent for this flat include water and heating?
answers: Does the rent for this flat include water and heating?
Does the rent for this apartment include water and heating?
items.notes: include 为及物动词；flat 常见于英式英语，apartment 常见于美式英语。

items.zh: 从昨晚开始，厨房的水龙头就一直在漏水。
items.en: The kitchen tap has been leaking since last night.
answers: The kitchen tap has been leaking since last night.
The kitchen faucet has been leaking since last night.
items.notes: 现在完成进行时表示动作从过去持续到现在；tap 也可用 faucet。

items.zh: 如果我提前退租，需要提前多久通知您？
items.en: How much notice do I need to give if I end the tenancy early?
answers: How much notice do I need to give if I end the tenancy early?
items.notes: give notice 表示提前通知；how much notice 询问通知期限。

items.zh: 请在我搬入之前，把现有损坏记录在交接清单上。
items.en: Please record the existing damage in the inventory before I move in.
answers: Please record the existing damage in the inventory before I move in.
items.notes: damage 在此不可数；inventory 指记录物品及状态的交接清单。

items.zh: 卧室朝向主路，所以我想晚上再来看一次房。
items.en: The bedroom faces the main road, so I'd like to view the flat again in the evening.
answers: The bedroom faces the main road, so I'd like to view the flat again in the evening.
items.notes: face 可直接接朝向对象；so 引出再次看房的理由。

items.zh: 我还没有收到押金退款，也没有收到扣款明细。
items.en: I haven't received my deposit back or an itemised list of deductions.
answers: I haven't received my deposit back or an itemised list of deductions.
I have not received my deposit back or an itemised list of deductions.
items.notes: 否定句中用 or 连接两个都未收到的项目；itemised 表示逐项列出的。

items.zh: 虽然暖气已经修好，但客厅的墙仍然很潮湿。
items.en: Although the heating has been repaired, the living-room wall is still damp.
answers: Although the heating has been repaired, the living-room wall is still damp.
items.notes: 现在完成时被动表示维修已完成；damp 描述潮湿状态。

items.zh: 您能在进入房屋检查之前和我约定一个时间吗？
items.en: Could you arrange a time with me before entering the property for an inspection?
answers: Could you arrange a time with me before entering the property for an inspection?
items.notes: arrange a time with sb 表示约定时间；before 后接动名词。

items.zh: 让我犹豫的是合同没有说明谁负责维修电器。
items.en: What makes me hesitate is that the agreement doesn't say who is responsible for appliance repairs.
answers: What makes me hesitate is that the agreement doesn't say who is responsible for appliance repairs.
What makes me hesitate is that the agreement does not say who is responsible for appliance repairs.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；be responsible for 表示负责。

items.zh: 除非有书面确认，否则我不想仅凭口头承诺续租。
items.en: Unless I receive written confirmation, I don't want to renew the tenancy on the basis of a verbal promise alone.
answers: Unless I receive written confirmation, I don't want to renew the tenancy on the basis of a verbal promise alone.
Unless I receive written confirmation, I do not want to renew the tenancy on the basis of a verbal promise alone.
items.notes: unless 表示如果不；on the basis of 表示依据，alone 强调仅凭这一点。

items.zh: 楼上的脚步声通常持续到午夜以后，影响了我的睡眠。
items.en: Footsteps from upstairs often continue past midnight, which disrupts my sleep.
answers: Footsteps from upstairs often continue past midnight, which disrupts my sleep.
items.notes: which 指代前一整件事；past midnight 表示午夜之后。

items.zh: 与其直接扣除整个押金，我们能否先核对一下维修报价？
items.en: Rather than deduct the whole deposit immediately, could we review the repair estimate first?
answers: Rather than deduct the whole deposit immediately, could we review the repair estimate first?
items.notes: rather than 引出替代方案；estimate 在此指预估维修费用。

items.zh: 租约从哪一天开始，到哪一天结束？
items.en: On what dates does the tenancy begin and end?
answers: On what dates does the tenancy begin and end?
items.notes: on what dates：具体哪些日期。

items.zh: 我能在签字前拿一份合同回去阅读吗？
items.en: May I take a copy of the agreement to read before signing?
answers: May I take a copy of the agreement to read before signing?

items.zh: 房间里的家具会全部留下吗？
items.en: Will all the furniture in the room remain?
answers: Will all the furniture in the room remain?

items.zh: 我需要知道这栋楼是否允许养宠物。
items.en: I need to know whether pets are allowed in this building.
answers: I need to know whether pets are allowed in this building.

items.zh: 公用洗衣房通常开放到几点？
items.en: Until what time is the shared laundry room usually open?
answers: Until what time is the shared laundry room usually open?

items.zh: 这扇窗关不紧，晚上有冷风进来。
items.en: This window does not close properly, and cold air comes in at night.
answers: This window does not close properly, and cold air comes in at night.
This window doesn't close properly, and cold air comes in at night.

items.zh: 浴室天花板上的水渍比上周更大了。
items.en: The water stain on the bathroom ceiling is larger than last week.
answers: The water stain on the bathroom ceiling is larger than last week.

items.zh: 停水会持续多久？我们需要提前储水吗？
items.en: How long will the water interruption last? Do we need to store water beforehand?
answers: How long will the water interruption last? Do we need to store water beforehand?

items.zh: 您安排的维修人员没有在约定时间出现。
items.en: The repairer you arranged did not arrive at the agreed time.
answers: The repairer you arranged did not arrive at the agreed time.
The repairer you arranged didn't arrive at the agreed time.

items.zh: 如果维修要持续几天，我需要了解期间的居住安排。
items.en: If the repairs take several days, I need to understand the living arrangements during that time.
answers: If the repairs take several days, I need to understand the living arrangements during that time.

items.zh: 厨房排风设备是否属于房东负责维护的部分？
items.en: Is the kitchen extractor part of what the landlord maintains?
answers: Is the kitchen extractor part of what the landlord maintains?

items.zh: 门锁有时打不开，我已经记录了发生的次数。
items.en: The lock sometimes fails to open, and I have recorded how often it happens.
answers: The lock sometimes fails to open, and I have recorded how often it happens.
The lock sometimes fails to open, and I've recorded how often it happens.
items.notes: fail to do：未能正常完成。

items.zh: 请确认电表读数是否从入住当天开始计算。
items.en: Please confirm whether the meter reading starts from the move-in date.
answers: Please confirm whether the meter reading starts from the move-in date.

items.zh: 我们想在墙上挂画，需要先获得书面同意吗？
items.en: Do we need written permission before hanging pictures on the wall?
answers: Do we need written permission before hanging pictures on the wall?

items.zh: 这份清单把旧划痕写成了新的损坏。
items.en: This list describes existing scratches as new damage.
answers: This list describes existing scratches as new damage.
items.notes: describe A as B：把 A 描述为 B。

items.zh: 我有入住时拍的照片，可以用来核对。
items.en: I have photographs taken when I moved in that we can use for comparison.
answers: I have photographs taken when I moved in that we can use for comparison.

items.zh: 能否把共用区域的清洁安排发给所有住户？
items.en: Could you send the shared-area cleaning schedule to all residents?
answers: Could you send the shared-area cleaning schedule to all residents?

items.zh: 楼道里的箱子挡住了通道，需要移开。
items.en: The boxes in the corridor are blocking the passage and need to be moved.
answers: The boxes in the corridor are blocking the passage and need to be moved.
items.notes: need to be moved：需要移开。

items.zh: 如果租金调整，您会提前多久通知？
items.en: How much notice will you give if the rent changes?
answers: How much notice will you give if the rent changes?

items.zh: 我想了解续约后的条款是否和现在相同。
items.en: I would like to know whether the terms will stay the same after renewal.
answers: I would like to know whether the terms will stay the same after renewal.
I'd like to know whether the terms will stay the same after renewal.

items.zh: 我们搬走后，最后一张账单会寄到哪里？
items.en: Where will the final bill be sent after we move out?
answers: Where will the final bill be sent after we move out?

items.zh: 钥匙需要本人交还，还是可以放到指定位置？
items.en: Must the keys be returned in person, or can they be left in a designated place?
answers: Must the keys be returned in person, or can they be left in a designated place?

items.zh: 这个车位是专用的，还是住户先到先用？
items.en: Is this parking space reserved, or is it available to residents on a first-come basis?
answers: Is this parking space reserved, or is it available to residents on a first-come basis?

items.zh: 虽然房间采光不错，但储物空间不够放我们的东西。
items.en: Although the room gets good daylight, it lacks enough storage for our belongings.
answers: Although the room gets good daylight, it lacks enough storage for our belongings.
